title: Panorama Water Tank Monitor — SCADA System Architecture
subtitle: Graphify Knowledge Graph & Architecture Intelligence

components.title: 4-20mA Hydrostatic Sensor
components.desc: Hydrostatic pressure probe submerged in coach water tank. Measures 0-200cm water column height with ±0.5% FS accuracy.

components.title: ESP32-S3 Microcontroller & FreeRTOS
components.desc: Dual-core Xtensa LX7 MCU running FreeRTOS tasks: ADC differential sampling, moving-average filter, and power management.

components.title: Quectel EC200U 4G LTE Modem
components.desc: Cellular IoT module executing UART AT commands (AT+QMTPUB) with auto-reconnection and exponential backoff retry.

components.title: Industrial MQTT Message Broker
components.desc: Standard MQTT broker handling telemetry ingest on 'panorama/{train_id}/telemetry' and WebSocket bridging on port 8083.

components.title: Backend MQTT Telemetry Ingestion Worker
components.desc: Asynchronous Paho client subscribing to raw telemetry, validating payload schema, and triggering 60s dead-man watchdogs.

components.title: WebSocket Real-Time Broadcast Service
components.desc: Maintains low-latency full-duplex socket connections (/ws/telemetry) to active SCADA supervisory client consoles.

components.title: FastAPI SCADA Application Core
components.desc: Python 3.12 ASGI engine providing path traversal sanitization, regex CORS origin protection, and security headers.

components.title: Authentication & RBAC Security Router
components.desc: Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Engineer, Operator). Enforces password hashing (bcrypt), token rotation, and audit logs.

components.title: Train, Coach & Tank Fleet Management
components.desc: SCADA consist management for 24-coach / 48-tank train configurations, coach mapping, and hardware UID binding.

components.title: Telemetry Evaluation & Alarm Engine
components.desc: Real-time 4-state level classification (Critically Low, Low, Normal, Full) and alarm acknowledgement lifecycle.

components.title: Database Engine (SQLite WAL / PostgreSQL)
components.desc: Async connection pool with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode for 500+ writes/sec concurrency without locking contention.

components.title: Clean Data Repositories
components.desc: Abstracted queries for tank states, historical aggregations, time-bucket downsampling, and transactional rollbacks.

components.title: Relational Data Models & Schemas
components.desc: Entities: Train, Coach, Tank, DeviceMapping, TelemetryRecord, AlarmEvent, AuditLog, and User.

layers.name: 5. OPERATOR SCADA HMI LAYER (REACT 18 / REACT NATIVE WEB)

components.title: SCADA State & Context Engine
components.desc: Global telemetry state store, active train context, dynamic device status engine, and 60s timeout tracking.

components.title: Hybrid REST & WSS Communication Service
components.desc: Dual-channel transport: JWT-authenticated REST client for CRUD + direct WebSocket MQTT client for real-time live telemetry.

components.title: Responsive SCADA Views & Dashboards
components.desc: Employee Dashboard, Train Consist Manager, Water Tank Grid, Live Tank Diagnostics, Alarms, Trends & History.

components.title: Adaptive Layout & Navigation Shell
components.desc: Unified interface adapting seamlessly across 1920x1080 supervisory desktop displays and 390x844 mobile handhelds.

components.title: Electron Desktop Process Supervisor
components.desc: Chromium 124 container managing native window state, hardware acceleration, and spawning the FastAPI backend daemon.

components.title: Sandboxed Secure IPC Bridge
components.desc: Context-isolated IPC bridge exposing safe desktop OS hooks (system info, app quit, theme sync) without nodeIntegration.
